create_vit_backbone: create a ViT backbone model for object detection with configurable depth, embed dim, and window attention
build_attention_block: build a multi-head attention block with relative positional embeddings and 2D rotary position embeddings
build_transformer_block: build a transformer block with window attention, layer normalization, and stochastic depth
create_mlp_layer: create an MLP layer for Vision Transformer with configurable hidden features and dropout
compute_rotary_embeddings: compute 2D rotary position embedding frequencies for query and key tensors in attention
